method: Tool image inspection of actual exported contact sheets, native PNGs and decoded-video contacts
observations: Fixed86 is clear around its observed time86 but grossly stretched and fragmented at early and late selected times
Fixed2 is clearer early and substantially distorted at middle and late selected times
Fixed188 is clearer late and substantially distorted at early and middle selected times
T1 and O1 retain the major fixed-view completeness problem
Opacity contains corresponding abnormal strips, connections and gaps; original-trajectory opacity also contains extra support that RGB hides
